svg.title: F-GILL · Gill folds
svg.desc: Several long, thin tissue folds project into surrounding water. A connected blood channel runs inside each fold, separated from the water by a thin tissue boundary. Labels identify water, the boundary and blood channels; no explanation of their effects is printed.
